repos.description: ADR secures enterprise AI agents through observability, security benchmarking, and threat detection. Deployed at Uber.
🛡️ A curated list of resources on agent skills security: attacks, defenses, frameworks, and benchmarks for securing AI agent tool use and skill ecosystems
MCPSecBench: A Systematic Security Benchmark and Playground for Testing Model Context Protocols
AI agents for pentesting, code audit, fuzzing, vulnerability discovery, and reverse engineering — harnesses, sandboxes, security MCP servers, benchmarks, and evals.
A comprehensive security benchmark for evaluating infrastructure-layer defenses in MCP-based AI agent systems

⚡ Awesome AI Gateway — pick an AI gateway from 160+ (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, Portkey, Kong, Higress, new-api, Bifrost) by cost, security & compliance, see what consolidated in 2026, learn how they actually work from an 8-chapter handbook, and verify every number yourself. Reproducible benchmarks, bilingual, updated daily.
Deterministic safety floor for tool-using AI agents: pre-execution gating, SafeFix suggestions, attack-chain detection, opt-in self-learning LLM judge. Papers: arXiv 2605.04785, 2606.08539
CIS-Style security audit tool for MCP server deployments — 7 categories, 35+ checks, CVE detection, and actionable remediation.
The quality gate for the MCP ecosystem. Spec compliance, security scanning, and performance benchmarks for MCP servers.

AI agent security harness, adversarial testing: 640 executable tests in the v4.26.1 release, across MCP, A2A, x402/L402, decision governance, benchmark integrity, human-in-the-loop, skill supply chain. Four target shapes: a verdict must be able to be wrong AND to be right. OWASP Agentic v1.1 T1-T17, AIUC-1 19/20 (2026-Q1/Q2 set), NIST AI 800-2.

Streaming privacy for LLM apps: pii-leak-benchmark (does your gateway leak PII in streams?), chunk-invariance (one-line test for split-boundary leaks), mcp-ssrf-check, and a self-hosted redacting gateway.
Post-Quantum Security Framework for Model Context Protocol (MCP) using ContextGuard. ICSCSA 2026 paper artifacts: HNDL/downgrade PoC, ML-KEM/ML-DSA benchmarks, HAF/HRS/HKF/RSP framework controls.
